new_page.title: Abbotsford Retail Space for Sale
new_page.description: Retail space for sale in Abbotsford: storefronts and retail strata units on the MLS®, with recent sales and the zones that allow retail.

faq_heading: Abbotsford Retail Space for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. For sale listings only.

Retail space for sale in Abbotsford: storefronts, retail strata units and retail buildings listed on the MLS®. For sale only; space for lease is not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.
In the second quarter of 2026, 5 of the 18 commercial sales in Abbotsford were retail & other properties, against 82 across the Lower Mainland.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
Abbotsford zones that allow retail uses
Each zone links to its full summary on the zoning guide. A zone that allows a use may still need a permit or a rezoning for a specific site, so check the address with the municipality before you buy.

faq.q: Does this page include retail space for lease?
faq.a: No, only property for sale. For lease listings, call or text Jared at 604-928-1361.

faq.q: How many retail properties sold in Abbotsford recently?
faq.a: 5 in the second quarter of 2026, out of 18 commercial sales in Abbotsford (GVR Commercial Edge).
